findings.title: souji-verify count_live_refs omits --hidden: hidden files are invisible to the stale-receipt sweep
evidence: tools/souji-verify.sh count_live_refs runs: rg -l --no-ignore --fixed-strings -e "$base" . -g '!.git' -g '!**/.git/**' -g '!souji-shokunin/census/**' -g '!**/souji-shokunin/census/**' -g '!souji-shokunin/tests/**' -g '!**/souji-shokunin/tests/**' -g '!**/.ufo-quarantine/**'  — no --hidden; `grep -n -- '--hidden' tools/souji-verify.sh` returns nothing.
Spec tools/souji-verify.spec.md D3 is worded the same way, so the tool faithfully implements a defective spec line.

Controlled reproduction (nothing mutated): /tmp/s23-gap-probe2 with a live reference ONLY inside a hidden dir (.ufo/waves/note.md contains 's23gap2.log'; the scratch file /tmp/s23-gap-probe2/s23gap2.log is 8 days old). rg without --hidden -> exit 1 (0 refs); rg with --hidden -> the hidden note. SHOKUNIN_ROOT=<probe> bash tools/souji-verify.sh /tmp/s23-gap-probe2/s23gap2.log -> VERDICT SAFE stale 'refs=0 mtime-age-days=8' — a FALSE-SAFE: a live reference exists and is skipped.

Real-world reachability of hidden refs for r3 targets: 18 hidden-inclusive hits for r87-C5, incl. lore-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-87/C5.md; all 24 r3 worktree targets have hidden-inclusive hits; e.g. r80-baseline -> 101.
findings.impact_on_this_ticket: none — /tmp/r87-C5 is a worktree registration, so evaluate_worktree decides it (metadata-prune) and the stale sweep is never reached. Same for all 19 lore + 2 gd2d detached registrations.
findings.impact_on_r3_deliverable: latent for the root-scratch removal list. Every PRESENT b2f2efa root file resolves SAFE(pushed) before try_stale runs (verified for all 56 present paths: tool=SAFE/pushed each), so the gap does not fire there today. It WILL fire on any unpushed, non-ledger scratch file whose only references live under a hidden path (.ufo/**, .scratch/** are hidden at fleet root).
findings.recommendation: Add --hidden to the D3 sweep in both the spec and the tool (and keep the .git exclusion), then re-run --selftest with a new fixture: scratch file + hidden-only reference -> NOT-SAFE. Until then, treat any SAFE(stale) verdict as unverified when the target's basename may be referenced under a dot-directory. Fix is out of this seat's write scope (tools/ is not a seat fragment surface).
